The curve on every theme is one on-resonance Rabi oscillation,
P = sin²(Ω t / 2) exp(−Γ t). The title stays inside the figure. The page mode
selects the light or dark slide pair, including the static print rendering.

```{python}
from review import anchors, for_renderings

def one(name, appearance, reading):
    return next(fig for fig in anchors(appearance, reading) if fig.layout.title.text == name)

def present(name, reading):
    config = {"staticPlot": True, "displayModeBar": False} if reading == "print" else {"displaylogo": False}
    for_renderings(lambda appearance: one(name, appearance, reading).show(config=config))
```

## Screen

### Tech Slate

```{python}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
present("Tech Slate", "screen")
```
